description: Lists topics trending right now across Google Trends (US realtime) and Polymarket (markets moving on volume), merged by topic, strongest first, each with score, score velocity per hour, first and last seen times, a type label (person, brand, event, place, meme, other), the headlines or market numbers behind it, and how many pump.fun launches in the last hour match it. Sources are polled every five minutes. Price: $0.01 per call in USDC (x402).

hours.description: Topics seen within this many hours (default 6).
